feeds.title: This Is Horror
feeds.description: This Is Horror specialises in horror fiction and the craft of writing. Stick around on This Is Horror and you can enjoy a podcast dedicated to readers, writers and creator, books written by some of the best minds in dark fiction today, Book reviews of the latest horror and genre releases, Thought-provoking features, Up-to-date news and much more

feeds.title: Horror Writers Association
feeds.description: THE HORROR WRITERS ASSOCIATION (HWA) is the oldest literary organization of writers and publishing professionals around the world, dedicated to promoting dark literature and the interests of those who write it.

feeds.title: Oldstyle Tales Press Blog
feeds.description: Oldstyle Tales Press publishes annotated and illustrated editions of classic horror, classic weird fiction, classic ghost stories, and gothic novels. From Dracula and Frankenstein to Henry James and Edgar Allan Poe, we illuminate your journeys through literature's darkest domains.

feeds.title: Too Much Horror Fiction
feeds.description: Too Much Horror Fiction collects and reviews vintage horror literature (mostly from the 1960s to the early 1990s) and celebrates its resplendent paperback cover art.

feeds.title: RA for All: Horror
feeds.description: The online home of The Readers Advisory Guide to Horror, an ALA publication. I am the author of The Readers Advisory Guide to Horror, 2d edition (ALA Editions, 2012). I can come to your library, book club meeting, or conference to talk about how to help your readers find their next good read.

feeds.title: Monster Complex Blog
feeds.description: Monster Complex is dedicated to monster stories in pop culture including literature, movies, TV, comics, and everything else.

feeds.title: HorrorAddicts.net » Books
feeds.description: Posts about BOOKS written by Horror Addicts Editor, Horror Addicts Guest, Emerian Rich, D.J. Pitsiladis, Stephanie Ellis, Daphne Strasert, Lionel Ray Green, and Naching T. Kassa. HorrorAddicts us your place to be when looking to read about the horror news, music, books, art history, location-based stories, and more.

feeds.title: Bark At The Ghouls
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Laurie. I review horror novels, sometimes horror films, and other fiction. My first love is dark fiction. This is the place where I review all the weird stuff I read.

feeds.title: Well Worth A Read
feeds.description: Covers book reviews, mostly horror, by Irene, an avid reader of horror novels and watcher of horror movies.

feeds.title: The Chrysalis Brew Project » Horror
feeds.description: The Chrysalis BREW Project, an Australia-based award-winning platform catering to all content creators and readers worldwide! This is where you'd find thoughts, words, photos, videos, and other ideas in the realm of Books, Reviews, and Everything Written (BREW). Check out our collection of horror book reviews, opinions and more!

feeds.title: Vogue Horror » Book Reviews
feeds.description: Explore thoughtful, critical reviews of horror fiction with clearly marked spoilers. My goal for Vogue Horror is simple at the moment: to give myself a creative outlet in a territory that I love.

feeds.title: The Horror Review
feeds.description: The Horror Review is part of the JournalStone Network. Born on March 15th 1999 as a Review Rating only site on one of the first free web hosts on the net. Read reviews focusing primarily in the horror, SciFi and Fantasy genres.

feeds.title: Indies Today » Horror
feeds.description: Indies Today seeks to recognize and support indie authors through our annual awards contest, editorial reviews, book reviewers directory list, and other affordable services and free resources. Read our horror book reviews, new books in market, authors and more!

feeds.title: FanFiAddict » Horror
feeds.description: A gaggle of nerds talking about Fantasy, Science Fiction, and everything in between. They also occasionally write reviews about said books. 2x Stabby Award-Nominated and home to the Stabby Award-Winning TBRCon. Explore our reviews on books from horror genre here.

feeds.title: Read By Dusk » Horror
feeds.description: This is the place for dark fiction books best read before nightfall. These books are primarily from the horror genre, but mystery, thriller, and Nordic noir are also available here. I share reviews and recommendations, as well as reading lists, essays, news, and other bookish information I find interesting.

feeds.title: Happy Goat Horror » Book Reviews
feeds.description: The aim of this site is simply to enjoy, talk/rant about, review, and promote horror - especially indie horror. We'll be discussing and promoting mainstream art, of course, but all of us goats are in agreement that indie horror is the heart of this project. We also want to highlight other horror sites and blogs.

feeds.title: mybookspage
feeds.description: Hi. I'm John Moralee. I write crime, horror, and science fiction, mostly for my own amusement, though I do like it when other people read and enjoy my stories. On my blog, I'll be posting personal stuff about writing, guest interviews, and a cartoon strip called Inside the Writer's Mind, which I hope to update fairly regularly with new jokes.

feeds.title: Burial Books Blog
feeds.description: Burial Books is a niche publication company that specializes in publishing horror and fantasy stories, novels, novellas, and other content. Their blog features stories and articles from authors across the spectrum. Take a closer look to find stories and short fiction that might tickle your spine.

feeds.title: Longbox of Darkness
feeds.description: I'm Herm, your resident blogger in Darkness. Welcome to The Longbox of Darkness, where we delve into all things spine-tingling and skin-crawling in the realm of comics, films, and fiction. If you've ever wondered who's working backstage, pulling back the proverbial curtain on horror's most chilling stories, that would be me, your humble horror guide.

feeds.title: GhostvilleHero » Horror Book Reviews
feeds.description: Ghostville is the city where I live. With roughly 50,000 people, Ghostville is filled with impressions of different lives; those that could have been lived, those that have been lived in the past, and those the became paths neglected for a different direction. The purposes of these writings are to share things that I enjoy. I want to share the best books, music, and movies that I can find. This section features reviews on horror books, new books and more!

feeds.title: SCREAM Magazine
feeds.description: The world's scariest publication, SCREAM - Blood, guts, gore & more! We are THE WORLD'S NUMBER ONE PRINT HORROR MAGAZINE. We cover films, celebrity interviews, DVDs/Blu-rays, festivals, books, games, comics, graphic novels, fiction/non-Fiction, photography, clothing/fashion, news, reviews, previews, competitions, on-location film reports & much, much more!

feeds.title: Bloody Disgusting » Book
feeds.description: All the latest on horror books including news, reviews, author interviews, and more. From Bloody Disgusting, your source for all things horror. The most trafficked horror site on the web, Bloody Disgusting features horror movies, music, video game, DVDs, indie, and comic news along with reviews, interviews, and a community of over 200,000 users.

feeds.title: Horror Cult Films » Book
feeds.description: Find the latest horror book reviews and news at Horror Cult Films from authors across the globe. Horror Cult Films was created late 2010, it covers most aspects of cinema, giving you all the latest news coverage, reviews and trailers you could handle!

feeds.title: Nocturnal Revelries » Ghost Stories
feeds.description: Posts about ghost stories written by dukederichleau

feeds.title: The Blog Where Horror Dwells
feeds.description: The Editor Formerly Known as Mr. Deathrealm. Author of BLUE DEVIL ISLAND, THE NIGHTMARE FRONTIER, THE LEBO COVEN, DARK SHADOWS: DREAMS OF THE DARK (with Elizabeth Massie), BALAK, YOUNG BLOOD (with Mat & Myron Smith), et. al. Feed at your own risk.

feeds.title: Jen Med's Book Reviews » Horror
feeds.description: The following section of Jen's blog is dedicated to reviews and articles on horror books. I'm Jen Lucas, a blogger who loves all things literature. Reading is one of my favorite ways to spend my spare time when I'm not working. I make no apologies for the length of my reviews. Short, long, and anything in between, they reflect how I feel about the book, nothing more nothing less.

feeds.title: Spooky Middle Grade Blog
feeds.description: At spookymiddlegrade.com, we seek to promote stories that honor and reflect the lives of all young people. We are a group of middle-grade authors working to prove that spooky stories serve an important role all year round. Check out our blog for articles about all things spooky.

feeds.title: The Gothic Library
feeds.description: A gothic book blog for dark-minded readers of all types. Julia, your Gothic Librarian, is a bibliophile and lover of literature. The only thing in her life that rivals her passion for books is her proclivity for the dark and macabre.

feeds.title: Horror News » Books
feeds.description: The following section of Horror News is your source to read about the new releases, reviews, and more on books. HNN is a full-featured Horror resource that focuses on News, Upcoming Horror Film Releases, Reviews, Articles, Interviews, Art, Trailers, and Industry Features. HNN is aimed at providing one of the Top resources for film and book reviews to consumers by covering a large spectrum of Horror titles combined with Cult films, Asian Horror, and Extreme Underground Films.

feeds.title: Dark Reads Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Dark Reads! My name is Toni. I decided to start this blog simply because I am a huge Horror and dark fiction fan. I just love books! I love reading books and talking about books, there is no better feeling than being completely lost in a book that just grabs you and stays under your skin long after you have finished reading it! I don't just read horror, I love dark fiction in general, this tends to fan out across several genres - Suspense, psychological, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, and others.

feeds.title: Dark Horror Tales
feeds.description: Follow and read horror movie spoilers, horror movie endings analyzed creepy urban legends and horror books. I find writing the most liberating exercise and one which helps me express my thoughts about the world I see. The amazing thing about writing and writing fiction especially is that I have total control over the world I'm creating for my characters.

feeds.title: Erica Robyn Reads
feeds.description: A book blog where I post book reviews, comic and graphic novel reviews, book tags, favorites lists, and other bookish-related things. I'm Erica Robyn, and I run on hot tea, good books, and loud music. My favorite genres are horror, thriller/suspense, mystery, and true crime.

feeds.title: Zezee with Books » Horror
feeds.description: Zezee with Books is a site by a book hoarder who reads just about anything but loves fantasy (adult and middle grade), literary fiction, comics and picture books. Check out Zezee's reviews of horror genre books, recommendations and more!

feeds.title: Diversity in Horror Fiction
feeds.description: A horror blog dedicated to works featuring and/or created by BIPOC, disabled people, and LGBTQIA+ folk. I'm a big horror fan. I grew up on Goosebumps and Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark. In 2014, inspired by the We Need Diverse Books campaign, I set out to find more horror fiction with diverse characters, and I've created this website to share my discoveries here with you, the good, the bad, and the truly terrifying.

feeds.title: Craig DiLouie Blog
feeds.description: Craig DiLouie is an author of popular thriller, apocalyptic/horror, and sci-fi/fantasy fiction. In hundreds of reviews, Craig's novels have been praised for their strong characters, action, and gritty realism. At this site, you can find all of Craig's major works, interviews, and hundreds of interesting blog posts.

feeds.title: Nightfire
feeds.description: Nightfire, an imprint of Tor Publishing Group, publishes across the breadth of the horror genre­ - from short story collections to novellas and novels, from standalone works to series, from dark fantasy to the supernatural, from originals to reprints of lost modern classics. Stay up to date with the latest Nightfire book announcements, ebook sales, excerpts, and the like.

feeds.title: Liam Smith
feeds.description: My name is Liam Smith and I write horror stories and gothic tales. I currently self-publish which you can check out on Amazon. This blog features announcements on my books, musings, horror book recommendations and reviews and more!

feeds.title: Denver Horror Collective
feeds.description: A collective for horror creators in the Denver area and beyond (the grave) including writing critique groups, a publishing house, The Epitaph newsletter, Dark Wisdom webinars, and public and online events. The mission of Denver Horror Collective is to facilitate, celebrate, and inspire horror writers and artists throughout Colorado and beyond (the grave).

feeds.title: Nightmare Magazine
feeds.description: Nightmare is a horror and dark fantasy magazine. In Nightmare's pages, you will find all kinds of horror fiction, from zombie stories and haunted house tales to visceral psychological horror. We believe that horror is for everyone, and we aim to publish the widest possible variety of the most delicious, spine-tingling tales.

feeds.title: SFFWorld » Book Reviews
feeds.description: SFFWorld is one of the Internet's largest and oldest online communities dedicated to the discussion of Science Fiction and Fantasy in print and on screen. REad more about newly released horror books, reviews and more!

feeds.title: The Scary Reviews
feeds.description: The Scary Reviews is Dedicated to Horror, Post Apocalyptic Fiction, and Thrillers. It is written by David, a Horror and post-apocalyptic fan living in a world that has moved on. I started this site because I've always been a huge horror fan and I wanted to have a place to post my favorite horror book reviews.

feeds.title: I Read, Therefore I Blog » Horror
feeds.description: This is a book review blog belonging to Caroline Hooton. I started reviewing books in 2006. I read all kinds of books - pretty much whatever takes my fancy - but I'm particularly fond of children's, young adult, crime fiction and thrillers and fantasy and SF. Explore my reviews of books I have read when I delve into the horror genre.

feeds.title: BookGeeks » Horror
feeds.description: Are you looking for some good Paranormal and Horror books to read? bookGeeks has one of the largest collection of reviews of Indian Horror Books and Novels written by authors like Ruskin Bond, Indra Das and Manish Mahajan. bookGeeks is the best Indian book blog. We are proud to have a collection of over 1000 book reviews and a community of over 70000 readers.

feeds.title: JenJenReviews » Horror/Thriller/Mystery
feeds.description: I go by Jenny online; feel free to call me Jenny or Jen. I decided to start this blog because I love reading but have a terrible memory. There are many books that I think about rereading only to realize that I don't remember if I even enjoyed them the first time. Browse through my horror and mystery section for all the books under horror, mystery and thriller genre.

feeds.title: A Literary Escape » Horror
feeds.description: I'm Celeste, a book reader turned book blogger. This is my outlet for sharing reviews and opinions about the books I read in the hopes of connecting with more avid bookworms. I mostly read fantasy books, but I also delve into nonfiction and science fiction. Find all the horror books I have red and my reviews of them in this section.

feeds.title: Kendall Reviews
feeds.description: UK based reviewer who's passionate about horror & the darker genres. Reviews, Interviews, guest posts and more.

feeds.title: Writer Dan Soule Blog
feeds.description: Peruse the blog from horror writer Dan Soule for musings on all things dark and filthy. If you are feeling brave, take a look around, and browse the stacks before the damp destroys the parchment.

feeds.title: Horror Bound Books
feeds.description: Horror Bound Books, created by Lancashire author Steve Woods, showcases his published and future novels. Born and bred in the city of Preston, Lancashire, Steve has a penchant for all things gruesome and often undead. His first novel 'When Evil Visits' was published in 2006.

feeds.title: Janine's Ghost Stories
feeds.description: Janine's Ghost Stories brings you ghost, horror, and supernatural tales that will hopefully send chills down your spine.

feeds.title: Mystery and Horror Blog
feeds.description: We are a micropress that publishes mystery and horror stories. Mystery and Horror, LLC was legally organized in 2011. It began as a writing partnership between Gwen Mayo and Sarah Glenn because they were going to the same conventions and events to promote their books. In 2013, the partners decided to expand into publishing other writers who share their love of genre fiction.

feeds.title: Scare Street
feeds.description: Scare Street is a collaboration between multiple horror book writers to create and consistently deliver high-quality scary stories! And that includes a collection of horror stories, ghost stories, and horror books. Our horror book writers are dedicated to delivering thrills and chills.

feeds.title: Njkinny's Blog » Horror
feeds.description: Find the best collection of creepy, spooky books on Njkinny's Blog and add them to your TBR. Njkinny is a hopeless book lover, binge reader, mom extraordinaire, passionate writer, 2019 NanoWrimo Winner, and winner of several writing contests. Her sole aim in life is to bring the awesomeness of books to the front of the world and she is happy to have already addicted her 4-year-old to them.

feeds.title: Folk Horror Revival
feeds.description: Folk Horror Revival is a gathering place to share and discuss Folk Horror in film, TV, books, art, music, events, and other media. We also explore psychogeography, hauntology, folklore, cultural rituals and costume, earth mysteries, archaic history, hauntings, Southern Gothic, 'landscapism / visionary naturalism & geography', backwoods, murder ballads, carnival, dark psychedelia, wyrd Forteana, and other strange edges.

feeds.title: Books Blog » Horror
feeds.description: Books Blog, from Sylv.net, is a blog which we have been running since 2012, we join blog tours daily where we share content for books of all genres. Check out the latest horror books, authors, announcements, reviews and recommendations and more!

feeds.title: Under the Covers Book Blog » Horror
feeds.description: Get our latest book recommendations, reviews and exclusive content about the Horror genre. We are avid readers and have found a passion for reading in almost all genres. We've been sharing our love for books online with anyone that would listen since 2011. The UTC Team has grown to a strong group of readers that will bring you a wide range of recommendations. You'll find reviews for romance, in all subgenres, urban fantasy, fantasy, sci-fi, thrillers, young adult and much more.

feeds.title: GORELETS Blog
feeds.description: I'm author Michael Arnzen. And GORELETS is my creative playground for all things related to horror and the uncanny. It has been for decades. I've been a writer, mostly working in the horror genre, since the late 1980s. I hold four Bram Stoker Awards and an International Horror Guild Award for my fiction, poetry and literary experiments. I continue to explore the strange corners where dark shadows continue to splay into new shapes of fear.

feeds.title: Speaking Bookish » Horror
feeds.description: My name is Summer and I'm a book reader, collector, and reviewer. Basically, a professional bookworm. As a reader, I lean towards fantasy/sci-fi both YA and adult, but I read just about anything and everything. Explore the horror section for reviews on the latest books from the genre, news and more!

feeds.title: Lionel Ray Green Blog
feeds.description: Lionel Ray Green is a horror and fantasy writer, an award-winning newspaper journalist, and a U.S. Army gulf war veteran. Keep up to date with his musings, announcements, reviews and more!

feeds.title: David's Book Blurg » Horror
feeds.description: I'm David. Mainly I'm into science fiction, historical fiction or fantasy books but I can enjoy pretty much any genre. The main reason behind this blog is that I see it all the time when reading reviews where the reader is comparing the book to another book they've read. I take each book on its own merits. Check out the reviews of horror books I have come across.

feeds.title: Mika Reads Horror Fiction
feeds.description: Reading vintage horror fiction from the 70s, 80s and 90s. Explore Horror novel reviews from the cold, dark north.

feeds.title: Harker US Book Blog » Horror
feeds.description: The Book Blog is a collection of book reviews and creative articles related to books and reading written by students and teachers at The Harker School in San Jose, CA. Upper School librarians Amy Pelman and Meredith Cranston serve as faculty editors and moderators. Check out reviews of books from the Horror genre.

feeds.title: Here's the Fucking Twist
feeds.description: I'm Krystin. Elder Millenial, 'writer', wife, stoner, homebody, story-lover, and unbothered bitch. I write chaotic book reviews without any bullshit for everything dark, twisty, and murdery.

feeds.title: Horror Novel Reviews
feeds.description: Horror Novel Reviews covers the work of inexperienced and veteran horror authors alike. They also incorporate interviews, guest reviews, news and feature articles.

feeds.title: Horror World
feeds.description: The Horror World is your source for horror news and reviews. Striving to bring you the latest and greatest of everything from the genre we love.

feeds.title: The Ginger Nuts Of Horror Review Website
feeds.description: Here you will find one of the most dedicated sets of horror fiction reviews on the web. Ginger Nuts of Horror Website can promote your horror product, from news items, interviews, reviews and guest posts we offer a wide range of options that can be customized to your needs.

feeds.title: Hellnotes
feeds.description: Hellnotes, owned by JournalStone Publishing, remains dedicated to bringing you the best information on the internet, covering horror movies, horror fiction, horror comics, horror writers, and more.

feeds.title: Erica Robyn Reads
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Erica Robyn, and I run on hot tea, good books, and loud music. On this blog, you will find book reviews from all kinds of genres ranging from Children's to Horror, though I have certainly transitioned to focusing mainly on horror! You'll also find plenty of comic and graphic novel reviews, book tags, favorites lists, bookish discussions, blogger hops, author interviews, and other bookish-related things.
